subject: math
title: Place Value: Tens and Ones
seo_title: Grade 1 Place Value Worksheets: Tens and Ones, Teen Numbers and Base-Ten Blocks
domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standard_text: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 place value worksheets: count tens and ones in base-ten blocks, teen numbers on ten-frames, what each digit means, 10, 20 … 90 as tens, and bundle story problems. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: 10 ones make 1 ten. In a 2-digit number, the first digit is tens and the last digit is ones.
key_sub: 47 is 4 tens and 7 ones. 16 is 1 ten and 6 ones. 50 is 5 tens and 0 ones.
body_html:
10 ones make 1 ten

Put 10 ones together. Now you have a bundle. We call it a ten.

Teen numbers

The numbers 11 to 19 are 1 ten and some ones. 16 is 1 ten and 6 ones.

Two digits: tens and ones

A 2-digit number has two places. The first digit tells the tens. The last digit tells the ones.

Count the blocks

There are 3 rods and 5 cubes. What number is it?

Count the rods by tens: 10, 20, 30. Count on the cubes: 31, 32, 33, 34, 35.

Answer: 35

What does the digit mean?

What does the 6 in 62 mean?

The 6 is first. It is in the tens place.

Answer: 6 tens, or 60

Tens with 0 ones

10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80 and 90 have 0 ones. 50 is 5 tens and 0 ones. The 0 shows there are no ones.

More than 9 ones

2 tens and 13 ones is ☐.

13 ones is 1 ten and 3 ones. So you have 3 tens and 3 ones.

Answer: 33

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up the digits (4 tens and 7 ones as 74)Tens come first: 47
Writing 4 tens and 7 ones as 407Use only 2 digits: 47
Counting a rod as 1 (4 rods and 7 cubes as 11)Each rod is 10: 10, 20, 30, 40, then 41 to 47
Adding 1 + 6 for 1 ten and 6 ones (7)1 ten is 10. 10 and 6 is 16
Writing 5 tens as 5Write 0 for 0 ones: 50

faq.q: What is place value in 1st grade math?
faq.a: In Grade 1, place value means a 2-digit number is made of tens and ones. In 47, the 4 means 4 tens (40) and the 7 means 7 ones.

faq.q: How do you explain teen numbers to a first grader?
faq.a: Show a full ten-frame or a bundle of 10 sticks, then some extra ones. 16 is 1 ten and 6 ones, so the 1 in 16 means 10, not 1.

faq.q: Why does my child write 74 for 47?
faq.a: They mix up which digit is the tens. Have them build the number with 4 rods and 7 cubes, then say “4 tens first, then 7 ones” as they write 47.

faq.q: How do you teach tens and ones at home?
faq.a: Bundle straws, sticks or pencils in groups of 10 with a rubber band. Ask your child to make a number with bundles and loose ones, then count by tens and count on the ones.
